basic_details.scholarship_name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Data Intelligence and Mining (DMIN)
basic_details.offering_entity: European Commission (EACEA) & DMIN Consortium (University of Lorraine, Technical University of Madrid, Politecnico di Milano)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: DMIN Consortium: University of Lorraine (France - Semester 1), Technical University of Madrid (UPM, Spain - Semester 2), Politecnico di Milano (PoliMi, Italy - Semester 3), and associated industrial partners (Semester 4 Thesis)
degree_levels: Master of Science (MSc Multiple / Joint Degree)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Data Intelligence, Data Mining, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Big Data Analytics, Cloud Architecture, and Knowledge Graphs.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~20 to 25 fully funded Erasmus Mundus scholarships awarded annually to top global applicants
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani data science, AI, and computing scholars selected annually
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: €1,400 / month tax-free living allowance (~PKR 420,000 / month) for 24 months (€33,600 total living stipend), plus 100% full participation fee waiver (€18,000 total), worldwide health insurance, and full relocation support

nationality_requirements: Open to applicants of all nationalities worldwide including Pakistan (Partner Country scholarship track)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (BSc / BS / BEng) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Electrical Engineering with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00 (or equivalent 78% marks) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00 with strong mathematical and programming foundations.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability and statistics, algorithms, data structures, and database systems.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate students completing degree requirements before July 31 of enrollment year.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Experience in Python, R, machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), or data analysis competitions (Kaggle) is advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (6.0 in all bands), TOEFL iBT minimum 85, PTE Academic minimum 62, or recognized English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an accredited degree-granting institution.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; 100% of the program is conducted in English across France, Spain, and Italy.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates apply via the DMIN consortium online portal and select 'Apply for Erasmus Mundus Scholarship'.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Previous recipients of an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree (EMJMD) scholarship are ineligible.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full coverage of university tuition and participation fees across all consortium partner universities.

admission_application_fee.details: Applying to DMIN is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student dormitories arranged in Nancy (France), Madrid (Spain), and Milan (Italy) (approx. €300 to €550 / month), paid easily from living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Flat monthly living allowance of €1,400 / month (~PKR 420,000 / month) disbursed directly to student's European bank account for the entire 24-month duration.

airfare.details: International mobility and travel expenses between host countries covered via the monthly €1,400 Erasmus Mundus allowance package.

visa_fee.details: Consortium provides official visa support letters; visa fees paid from monthly living allowance.

health_insurance.details: Full worldwide medical, travel, and accident insurance compliant with EACEA standards provided for 24 months.

food_allowance.details: Affordable student dining across host campuses (CROUS in France, student dining in Madrid and Milan); monthly stipend easily covers all food expenses.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to high-performance computing clusters (Jean Zay supercomputer access in France, MareNostrum links in Spain), GPU labs, and digital libraries.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Summer schools, data science hackathons, and master's thesis research with corporate AI partners fully funded.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized local transit passes provided in Nancy, Madrid, and Milan during study terms.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions across Europe (DMIN Consortium).
participating_institutions: Technical University of Madrid (UPM, Spain - Semester 2)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier European AI and data mining consortium supported by the European Union Erasmus+ program.
available_majors: Joint Master in Data Intelligence and Mining (Foundations of Data Mining & AI)
Joint Master in Data Intelligence and Mining (Big Data Architecture & Cloud Analytics)
Joint Master in Data Intelligence and Mining (Deep Learning & Knowledge Graphs)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in CS/Data Science/Math with CGPA >= 3.20/4.00, academic transcripts, two letters of recommendation, motivation letter, CV, and English proficiency certificate (IELTS 6.5+ / TOEFL 85+ / MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Consortium receives applications centrally; candidates are evaluated globally for Erasmus Mundus scholarship ranking.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight technical competencies in mathematical modeling, machine learning algorithms, database management, and Python data science pipelines.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the DMIN portal during open intake (November to January), fill out application form, select Erasmus Mundus scholarship track, upload credentials, and register recommenders.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check admission prerequisites and required documents on master-dmin.eu.
Step 2: Register on DMIN application portal (open November).
Step 3: Complete online application and write motivation statement detailing data science interest.
Step 4: Upload transcripts, degree certificate, CV, and English proficiency proof.
Step 5: Register two academic referees who submit evaluation letters online.
Step 6: Consortium Academic Board evaluates applications and shortlists candidates.
Step 7: Shortlisted candidates participate in online technical interview via Zoom in February.
Step 8: Final scholarship results announced in March/April.
Step 9: Apply for French visa and travel to Nancy, France in September for Semester 1.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Consortium Route: Admission and Erasmus Mundus scholarship are evaluated together in a single application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two academic referees via confidential email links generated by DMIN portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Motivation Letter (max 1,000 words) describing your passion for data intelligence, mathematical foundations, career goals, and how DMIN aligns with your ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of final-year undergraduate project or technical data science portfolio.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV format detailing education, programming proficiencies (Python, SQL, R), data science frameworks, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview via Zoom conducted by Consortium Academic Committee evaluating linear algebra, statistics, algorithms, and machine learning concepts.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 85+, PTE 62+, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate accepted.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified true copies of transcripts and degree certificates; HEC and MoFA attestations required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified official English translation for all non-English documents.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete Bachelor's degree certificate and transcripts with grading scale and CGPA >= 3.20/4.00.
Detailed essay (max 1,000 words) explaining technical background, data science interest, and career goals.
Confidential evaluation letters from university professors on institutional letterhead.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped with official university seals.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (6.0 in all bands), TOEFL iBT 85+, or official MOI certificate.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official test report or MOI letter.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Standard Europass CV detailing education, programming languages, data frameworks, and projects.
Clear color copy of passport bio-data page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: January 15 (Strict annual Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for autumn intake; application call runs November to mid-January.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Technical projects, data science portfolio, undergraduate thesis)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 10% (Practical industry internships, machine learning roles, or Kaggle competitions)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality, clarity, and technical coherence of motivation letter)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: DMIN Consortium Selection Board representing University of Lorraine, UPM Madrid, and PoliMi.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-tier holistic evaluation selecting top applicants globally based on academic merit and technical potential.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.0% to 3.5% for applicants with strong computing foundations and CGPA >= 3.50
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00, accompanied by strong practical data science projects or publications
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science, data science, software engineering, or mathematics with solid coding skills in Python and machine learning knowledge.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from top Pakistani universities (FAST-NUCES, NUST, UET Lahore, COMSATS, GIKI, Quaid-i-Azam).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Turkey, Brazil, Egypt, Indonesia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official portal master-dmin.eu.
Erasmus Mundus programs never charge application fees or work with private recruitment agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying to DMIN is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agency written statements are disqualified; personal technical knowledge is tested during video interviews.
hidden_costs_breakdown: French Long-Stay Student Visa fee in Pakistan: ~PKR 25,000.
Spanish and Italian visa processing in subsequent terms: Handled smoothly via intra-EU student mobility rules.
One-way flight to France: ~PKR 150,000 to 220,000 (reimbursed via monthly stipend).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need French, Spanish, or Italian fluency. Reality: 100% of the program is conducted in English.
Myth: Work experience is mandatory. Reality: Fresh graduates with strong final-year projects are fully competitive.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites cite old EMJMD travel grant rules; the new Erasmus Mundus model provides a flat €1,400/month stipend encompassing living, travel, and installation.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain satisfactory academic standing and pass all coursework modules (minimum 60 ECTS credits per year).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance at designated consortium universities (Semester 1 in France, Semester 2 in Spain, Semester 3 in Italy).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit evaluation by Consortium Joint Academic Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may not engage in full-time commercial employment during the 24-month funded scholarship period.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation (scholars may pursue international doctorates or industrial careers).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if candidate abandons studies or fails academic examinations across consecutive attempts.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Mandatory mobility between partner institutions according to designated study tracks.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Fixed curriculum in Data Intelligence and Mining.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship tenure is strictly 24 months; no extensions permitted.
